stories.title: Links featured on KARE 11 News
stories.summary: Here are the latest links mentioned on KARE 11 newscasts.

stories.title: Golden Valley Fire Chief Brunsell resigns; Assistant Fire Chief Guzman on leave amid complaint
stories.summary: The latest abrupt departure from Golden Valley's top public safety leadership follows last year's resignation of Police Chief Virgil Green.

stories.title: Gophers part ways with Offensive Coordinator Greg Harbaugh
stories.summary: Harbaugh was named offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach in 2025.

stories.title: Missing hunter found dead in Wild Rose Wildlife Management Area
stories.summary: Chisago County Sheriff's Office announced that search crews found the body, believed to be that of the missing hunter, on Saturday afternoon.

stories.title: Hopkins police investigate Uber-related assault after man left in critical condition
stories.summary: Officers located the suspect nearby and took him into custody.

stories.title: Children’s Theatre Company presents 'Dr. Seuss's How the Grinch Stole Christmas!'
stories.summary: Actress Matea Córdova Stuart, who plays Cindy-Lou Who, visited KARE 11 on Sunday to discuss the show and her role.

stories.title: 'Sunday Sounds': BEV
stories.summary: Local indie rock band BEV performs "Soft T-Shirt" from their new record "Expectations" on KARE 11 Sunday.

stories.title: Momo Sushi reopens in northeast Minneapolis over year after fire
stories.summary: Owner and Chef Sonam Nyorie stopped by KARE 11 on Sunday to share more about how the reopening has been going so far.

stories.title: Mini Lambeau Field brings Vikings and Packers fans together for a friendly rivalry
stories.summary: The venue offers a place to enjoy the game, a cold drink, and some friendly competition.

stories.title: Missing hunter found dead in Chisago County wildlife management area
stories.summary: At approximately 4:30 p.m. Saturday, search teams located an adult male believed to be Altepeter, deceased inside the wildlife management area.

stories.title: Suspect, another person dead after law enforcement shooting in Lindstrom
stories.summary: As of Saturday afternoon, authorities said there is no threat to the public.

stories.title: Body found in submerged vehicle in Farmington pond
